title: Embryo-derived human chorionic gonadotropin promotes human decidualization through activating epithelial prostaglandin F2alpha secretion
candidate_claim: In Ishikawa epithelial cells acute hCG (5 ug/mL, 1 h; 0.2 ug/mL is ns for most readouts) raises p-cPLA2, COX-1, COX-2 and AKR1C3 protein (Fig 1C-J) and raises medium PGF2a from 102 to 142 pg/mL (Fig 2B). Exogenous PGF2a (0.1-1 nM, 4 h) raises secreted EREG and HB-EGF (Fig 3B) and, more weakly, whole-cell AREG, EREG, HB-EGF, PTGFR and the 120 kDa pro-ADAM17 band, all reduced by 1 uM AL-8810 (Fig 3A/3D-3L). ADAM17 was NEVER perturbed and no activation, mature-form or sheddase-activity measurement exists, so 'activating ADAM17' is NOT supported. Under db-cAMP (250 uM) plus MPA (1 uM) in CRL-4003 stromal cells, EREG (50 ng/mL, 4 d) and HB-EGF (100 ng/mL, 1 d) each raise IGFBP1 mRNA and IGFBP1 and PRL protein, whereas AREG (50 ng/mL, 4 d) does NOT (all ns, Fig 4A-L). PGF2a applied directly to stromal cells also raises IGFBP1 and PRL (Fig 4M-P), at a concentration labelled 100 nM in-panel but 1 nM in the caption for N/O/P. Strongest result: epithelial-side siEREG or siHB-EGF in a non-contact pillar-suspended coculture, each abolishing the hCG- and PGF2a-driven stromal IGFBP1 increment (Fig 5D/5E/5G/5H). CRITICAL GAP: hCG is never applied to epithelium under PGF2a blockade, so PGF2a mediation of the hCG effect is inferred, not demonstrated; hCG is never applied directly to stromal cells; LHCGR is never mentioned or measured. Human tissue (Fig 6) peaks at LH+2, not LH+7, with no stated sample size.
source_of_discovery: EuropePMC 2026-07-28 query: chorionic gonadotropin AND endometrial stromal AND IGFBP1 AND decidualization
notes: Full text inspected 2026-07-29 (PDF-027/PDF-028 batch; registered as REF-059); all 13 pages figure-rendered. Every field previously recorded as NOT obtainable is now answered: hCG 0.2 and 5 ug/mL for 1 h (enzymes, PGF2a, coculture pretreatment) and 6 h (receptivity molecules), i.e. ACUTE only, no chronic arm, and only 5 ug/mL is reliably active; epithelium is Ishikawa (Cell Bank CAS Shanghai) and stroma is ATCC CRL-4003, both immortalised lines with NO primary cells or organoids anywhere; decidualization is 250 uM db-cAMP plus 1 uM MPA for 1, 2 or 4 d; ADAM17 was NOT perturbed by any means (no siRNA, no TAPI-0/TAPI-2/marimastat, no activity assay) and is only blotted as a single 120 kDa pro-form, so the PGF2a-to-ADAM17 step stays composite_or_inferred; epithelial-to-stromal signalling was shown by a genuine non-contact pillar-suspended COCULTURE (Methods 2.3), not conditioned medium, so the inter-compartment step is direct; figure and table locations are recorded in docs/curation_increment_06_somkuti_jin.md. LHCGR is not mentioned anywhere in the FULL TEXT either (0 occurrences), so the LHCGR question resolves as UNTESTED, not as evidence of absence, and no LHCGR edge may be inferred. Data-integrity flags: Fig 4M-P PGF2a is 100 nM in-panel and in the Results but 1 nM in the caption for N/O/P, with Methods giving no concentration at all; AL-8810 is 50 uM there against 1 uM in Figs 2H/2O/3A, with no antagonist-alone arm anywhere; the human-tissue arm reports NO sample size, its Methods 2.4 containing only ethics text (approval 2013-081-01). Interpretive flag: Fig 6 places AKR1C3, PTGFR, EREG and HB-EGF at maximum at LH+2 and near baseline by LH+7, i.e. before an embryo exists, which the paper never confronts. Causal resolution: the full hCG to PGF2a to EREG/HB-EGF chain was NEVER tested end to end - no arm applies hCG under PGF2a-receptor blockade or COX inhibition - so the route is assembled from separate sufficiency experiments and its central mediation joint is inferred. seed_confidence is deliberately UNCHANGED: per README that column measures how useful a paper is as a search lead, not evidence strength, and re-purposing it as an evidence grade would repeat the tier-confusion this table is meant to avoid.
